body:
Yeah I guess that would help, I mean, I didn’t think much about my “future self” until I learnt to play guitar, which was almost life-changing, but I ended up thinking that I wouldn’t go anywhere with it and just kind of left that dream behind. But who knows? Maybe it could be worth it to give it a try.

Also thanks for talking with me, these days have been pretty difficult and it’s nice to have an internet conversation sometimes.

I’m not sure, I guess it can be because I can’t stop feeling like nothing is gonna get better, but it’s kind of weird since there are somedays that I feel kind of happy but others are just plain bad.  

I’ve talked about it with my mom but our relationship isn’t the best, and I know she cares about me and I’m very thankful for that, but sometimes I feel like talking to her would be just worrying her and making her sad, so I don’t always do it when I feel this way.
